mechanism: Tranylcypromine (MAOI) combined with scopolamine (anticholinergic) potentiates anticholinergic effects and increases risk of hypertensive crisis via sympathomimetic potentiation and reduced norepinephrine metabolism.
action: Avoid concurrent use; if scopolamine is necessary, use lowest dose with careful blood pressure monitoring and consider alternative anticholinergic agents with less sympathomimetic interaction potential.
